description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SearchEngineNotFoundException' used in the Search component of SuiteCRM. It extends the base 'SearchException' class and is part of the 'SuiteCRM\Search\Exceptions' namespace. The file also contains license and copyright information typical for a PHP source file.

classes.name: SearchEngineNotFoundException
